host.label: HyperHDR address
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the machine HyperHDR runs on.

udp_port.label: UDP raw receiver port
udp_port.description: Port of HyperHDR's UDP raw receiver. Switch the receiver on in HyperHDR under Network Services, for the LED instance you want to drive.

web_port.label: Web port
web_port.description: Port of HyperHDR's web interface, used once to read how the LEDs are arranged.

token.label: API token
token.description: Only needed when HyperHDR runs on another machine and asks for authorization. Create one in HyperHDR under Advanced, Network Services, Token Management. Leave empty to keep the stored token.

effect.label: Effect
effect.description: How the music is drawn on the LEDs.

options.spectrum: Spectrum: bass at the bottom, treble at the top
options.pulse: Pulse: all LEDs flash on the beat
options.ripple: Ripple: a wave on every beat
options.energy: Energy: bass, mids and treble bars
options.ambient: Ambient: calm colours that breathe with the music

palette.label: Colours
palette.description: Colours used by the effect. Album artwork follows the cover of the current track and falls back to rainbow when a cover has no usable colours.

brightness.label: Brightness (%)
brightness.description: Brightness of the effect, on top of the brightness set in HyperHDR.

sensitivity_db.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity_db.description: How strongly the lights react. The level adapts to each track by itself; increase this if the effects look dim or flat, decrease it if they are stuck at maximum.

response.label: Light response
response.description: How quickly the lights follow the music.

latency_ms.label: Light timing (ms)
latency_ms.description: Makes the lights react slightly earlier so they stay in step with your speaker. Increase if the lights lag the music.

user.title: Connect to HyperHDR
user.description: Enter the address of the machine HyperHDR runs on. In HyperHDR, switch on the UDP raw receiver under Network Services first.

manifest.name: HyperHDR Sync
manifest.description: Make the ambient LEDs driven by HyperHDR react to the music played by Music Assistant.

errors.cannot_connect: Could not reach HyperHDR. Check the address and web port, and that HyperHDR is running.
errors.auth_required: HyperHDR asks for authorization. Enter an API token created in HyperHDR under Token Management.
errors.no_leds: HyperHDR reports no LEDs. Set up the LED layout in HyperHDR first.
errors.too_many_leds: This HyperHDR instance has more than 500 LEDs, which its UDP raw receiver cannot take.
errors.already_configured: This HyperHDR instance is already set up.
